model.A: Original sealed preconception, original intent, promised functions and preserved architecture.
model.B: Research-driven expansion: realistic best practices, technical possibilities and improvements beyond A.
model.C: Accumulated field feedback, user work preferences, corrections and later requirements.

B: Official Android documentation research captured in BCP_CANONICAL_SPEC_ABC_R77.md
C: User field screenshots/observations reflected in project state

scoring_rule: Per requirement: 0 missing, 1 designed/researched, 2 implemented partial/candidate, 3 CI/process qualified, 4 field verified. The maturity score does not substitute for separate field verification.
